title: Why Spring Smells Different
short_teaser: Moist soil, plant growth, rain, and microbial activity create distinctive spring scents.
story: Moist soil, plant growth, rain, and microbial activity create distinctive spring scents. A season can be recognized through chemistry before the eye sees every change. Curiosity loosens assumptions and creates room for better questions. The value is not only knowing the story, but recognizing where the same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
